newsitem.title: SPAIN: Two dead stowaways found on ship in Spanish port.
newsitem.headline: Two dead stowaways found on ship in Spanish port.

text.p: The bodies of two dead stowaways were discovered on Sunday in a Cypriot ship docked off the coast of northern Spain, civil authorities said.
Police sources said the two were north Africans who apparently suffocated to death and their bodies were in a state close to mummification.
The dead men were discovered by a member of the ship's crew and may have been on board since November when the vessel was last in port.
The cargo ship "Deike" was unloading steel in the port of Pasajes in Guipuzcoa province, located in Spain's Basque country.
The bodies were taken to a forensic institute in nearby San Sebastian for autopsies.
